name: Pickup technical with M40 106 mm recoilless rifle
armament: M40 106 mm recoilless rifle on a pedestal mount in the bed (often with its .50-cal spotting rifle removed)
protection: Unarmoured pickup (Land Cruiser 70-series or Hilux). Game rule treats the vehicle body as immune to small-calibre, but 7.62x54R and up penetrate; crew and gun are fully exposed. The backblast zone behind the bed is a gameplay hazard for nearby AI.
visual_notes: Very long, thin 106 mm barrel overhanging the cab roof, mounted on a pedestal in the bed
Barrel often wrapped or painted; spotting rifle tube above the barrel on some
Land Cruiser 79 single-cab or Hilux chassis; cab roof sometimes cut down for traverse
Ammunition tubes and spare tyres stacked in the bed
